keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «커다란 문어가 배를 붙잡았다(문제)» 와 «싸우는 것보다 친절한 것이 낫다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (a giant octopus holds the ship) and the lesson (being kind is better than fighting). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Pirate Pete, his pirates, and a giant octopus
A giant octopus holds the ship, and the pirates are scared.
Pete gives the hungry octopus a big bag of fish, and it lets go.

words: A giant octopus holds it with eight long arms!
A giant octopus holds it with eight long arms!
a sea animal with eight long arms

opts: The ship hits a big rock.
evs: A giant octopus holds it with eight long arms!
Pirate Pete sails his ship across the sea.
Pete gives it a big bag of fish.
why: «A giant octopus holds it with eight long arms!» 커다란 문어가 여덟 개의 긴 다리로 배를 붙잡아서 배가 멈춰요.
A giant octopus holds the ship with eight long arms, so the ship stops.

qs.q: "The pirates shake with fear." What does "shake with fear" mean?
qs.qko: «The pirates shake with fear.» 에서 «shake with fear» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: their bodies move because they are very scared
they dance because they are happy
they are cold from the rain
evs: He looks at the octopus. It looks sad and hungry.
The octopus smiles and lets go of the ship.
why: «But Pete is not scared.» «하지만» 피트는 무섭지 않아요. 그러니 다른 해적들은 무서워서 몸이 떨린다는 뜻이에요.
"But Pete is not scared." This tells us the other pirates are scared, so their bodies shake.

qs.q: Why does the octopus let go of the ship?
opts: It is hungry, and Pete gives it fish.
The pirates shout at it very loudly.
It is afraid of the pirates.
evs: He looks at the octopus. It looks sad and hungry.
Pete gives it a big bag of fish.
why: 문어는 슬프고 배고파 보였고(«He looks at the octopus. It looks sad and hungry.»), 피트가 물고기 한 자루를 주었어요(«Pete gives it a big bag of fish.»). 배가 부른 문어는 웃으며 배를 놓아줘요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The octopus is sad and hungry, and Pete gives it a big bag of fish. So it smiles and lets go. You need both sentences.

ends: The octopus becomes Pete’s friend and helps push the ship.
문어가 피트의 친구가 되어 배를 밀어 준다.
Pete and the pirates find a treasure map in the sea.
피트와 해적들이 바다에서 보물 지도를 찾는다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>Pete is kind</u> because <u>he gives the octopus fish</u>.”

img.cover: On the blue sea, a giant pink octopus with big round eyes and long curly arms wraps its long arms around a wooden pirate ship with white sails, and a man with a curly black beard, a red bandana, a blue and white striped shirt and a gold earring stands at the front of the ship smiling and holding out a big sack of fish to it.

scenes.1: On the deck of a wooden pirate ship with white sails, a few funny cartoon pirates in striped shirts peek out from behind wooden barrels with surprised faces, while a friendly man with a curly black beard, a red bandana, a blue and white striped shirt and a gold earring calmly looks up at a giant pink octopus with big round eyes and long curly arms, which has droopy eyes and a sad, hungry look on its face.
scenes.2: On the sunny blue sea, a man with a curly black beard, a red bandana, a blue and white striped shirt and a gold earring hands a big sack of fish to a giant pink octopus with big round eyes and long curly arms, which smiles happily and lets go of a wooden pirate ship with white sails as the pirates cheer.
